mergedParams.userDescription: Grunge textures and distressed edges. internal effects for text, video, images

output.title: Grunge Textures & Distressed Edges - Internal Effects

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'grunge-distress-edges' that applies a distressed, worn edge effect to any component. The effect should animate custom CSS filters and clip-path to create a rough, torn paper aesthetic. Use generic AnimationRange effects that combine multiple filter properties including contrast, brightness, and custom SVG filters for texture. The effect should accept parameters for intensity (0-1), edgeRoughness (smooth/medium/rough), and animationDuration. Implement a multi-stage animation that first applies a subtle pulsing distortion, then gradually increases edge roughness using clip-path polygon animations. The effect should target components via targetIds and use GPU-accelerated transforms. Include a grunge texture overlay using CSS filter url() references to SVG filters defined in the effect data.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties animated: filter (contrast, brightness, url(#grunge-filter)), clipPath, opacity. AnimationRange structure: [{key: 'filter', val: 'contrast(1.2) brightness(0.9) url(#grunge)', prog: 0}, {key: 'filter', val: 'contrast(1.5) brightness(0.85) url(#grunge)', prog: 0.5}, {key: 'filter', val: 'contrast(1.3) brightness(0.95) url(#grunge)', prog: 1}]. Clip-path uses polygon with random vertices. Input params: z.object({intensity: z.number().min(0).max(1), edgeRoughness: z.enum(['smooth', 'medium', 'rough']), duration: z.number()}). Return format: {effects: [{type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, start: 0, duration, ranges}]}. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}.

prompts.prompt: Design a waveform-based internal effect preset 'audio-grunge-shake' that creates a distressed, jittery movement synchronized with audio beats. The effect should react to bass frequencies to create an organic, unstable shake that mimics old film projector wobble. Implement both positional shake (translateX/Y) and rotational instability (rotate) that intensifies during bass hits. The effect should layer multiple shake frequencies - a constant micro-shake for texture plus impact shakes on beats. Include parameters for shakeIntensity, bassThreshold, and decaySpeed to control how quickly the shake settles after each beat. Add a subtle zoom pulse that creates a breathing effect synchronized with mid-range frequencies.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (audio-reactive). Waveform configuration: {type: 'shake', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.8, threshold: 0.6}. Additional waveform: {type: 'zoom', audioProperty: 'mid', sensitivity: 0.3}. Effect combines translateX, translateY, rotate, and scale. Input params: z.object({shakeIntensity: z.number().default(1), bassThreshold: z.number().min(0).max(1), decaySpeed: z.number()}). Return format: {effects: [{type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds, props: {shake: {intensity, decay}, zoom: {scale: 1.05}}}]}. Real-time audio analysis via useWaveformData hook. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: {presets: []}}.

prompts.prompt: Build a combined internal effect preset 'grunge-film-burn' that simulates aged film burn and light leak effects. Create a complex animation sequence using generic effects that cycles through exposure bursts, color shifts to sepia/amber tones, and vignette darkening. The effect should animate CSS filters including brightness (creating overexposure flashes), sepia (for vintage color grading), and custom gradients for burn marks. Include a flickering opacity effect that simulates film damage. Accept parameters for burnIntensity, colorTone (sepia/amber/bleached), and flickerRate. The animation should have irregular timing to feel organic and unpredictable, using cubic-bezier easing for natural light blooms.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined (multiple generic effects). Properties: brightness, sepia, saturate, opacity, background (radial-gradient for vignette). AnimationRange examples: [{key: 'filter', val: 'brightness(1)', prog: 0}, {key: 'filter', val: 'brightness(2.5) sepia(0.4)', prog: 0.3}, {key: 'filter', val: 'brightness(0.7) sepia(0.8)', prog: 0.7}]. Opacity flicker: [{key: 'opacity', val: 1, prog: 0}, {key: 'opacity', val: 0.85, prog: 0.1}]. Input params: z.object({burnIntensity: z.number(), colorTone: z.enum(['sepia', 'amber', 'bleached']), flickerRate: z.number()}). Return format: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: brightnessRanges}, {type: 'generic', ranges: opacityRanges}]}. Easing: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'distressed-text-glitch' specifically for text elements that adds a digital distortion aesthetic. Implement a multi-layer effect combining text-shadow animations for RGB channel separation, letter-spacing glitches, and transform skewing. The effect should create brief moments where text appears to split into cyan/magenta components (chromatic aberration), combined with horizontal displacement glitches. Include parameters for glitchIntensity, chromaOffset (pixel offset for RGB split), and glitchFrequency. Use spring easing for snappy glitch recovery. The effect should be optimized for text readability, ensuring glitches are brief and don't completely obscure content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: textShadow (RGB split), letterSpacing, transform (skewX), translateX. AnimationRange: [{key: 'textShadow', val: '2px 0 #0ff, -2px 0 #f0f', prog: 0.2}, {key: 'letterSpacing', val: '0.05em', prog: 0.3}, {key: 'transform', val: 'skewX(5deg) translateX(3px)', prog: 0.35}]. Spring easing for recovery. Input params: z.object({glitchIntensity: z.number(), chromaOffset: z.number(), glitchFrequency: z.number()}). Targets text atoms specifically. Return format: {effects: [{type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: ['text-*'], duration: 0.2, ranges}]}. PresetMetadata includes text-specific optimizations.

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset 'grunge-noise-overlay' that adds animated film grain and dust particles to any component. Create a dynamic noise texture using CSS filters and pseudo-elements that constantly shifts to simulate analog film grain. The effect should layer multiple noise patterns - a fine grain base layer, larger dust specks that move across the frame, and occasional scratches. Implement this using animated background-images with noise patterns, opacity fluctuations, and blend modes. Parameters should include grainDensity, dustAmount, and scratchFrequency. The noise should be GPU-accelerated using transform3d for smooth performance.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic with background animations. Properties: backgroundImage (noise texture URLs), backgroundPosition, opacity, mixBlendMode. AnimationRange: [{key: 'backgroundPosition', val: '0 0', prog: 0}, {key: 'backgroundPosition', val: '100px 100px', prog: 1}]. Continuous loop for grain movement. Input params: z.object({grainDensity: z.enum(['light', 'medium', 'heavy']), dustAmount: z.number(), scratchFrequency: z.number()}). Uses CSS custom properties for dynamic noise generation. Return format: {effects: [{type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, ranges, cssVars: {'--noise-opacity': density}}]}. Transform3d for GPU acceleration.

prompts.prompt: Build a waveform-based internal effect preset 'bass-distortion-pulse' that warps and distorts elements in sync with bass drops. Create an effect that combines scale distortion (non-uniform scaling on X/Y axes), blur pulsing, and contrast pumping that reacts to low-frequency audio. The distortion should create a 'speaker cone' effect where elements appear to bulge outward on bass hits. Include rotation wobble that increases with sustained bass. Parameters for bassResponse (how much distortion per bass level), distortionShape (circular/horizontal/vertical), and recovery time. The effect should use threshold detection to only activate on significant bass events.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (bass-reactive). Multiple waveform configs: [{type: 'scale', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 1.2}, {type: 'blur', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.5}, {type: 'rotate', audioProperty: 'waveform', sensitivity: 0.3}]. Non-uniform scaling: scaleX and scaleY animated independently. Input params: z.object({bassResponse: z.number(), distortionShape: z.enum(['circular', 'horizontal', 'vertical']), recoveryTime: z.number()}). Threshold: 0.7 for bass activation. Return format: {effects: [{type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds, props: {scale: {x: 1.3, y: 1.1}, blur: 2, rotate: 5}}]}. Real-time bass analysis with decay curves.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'vintage-vhs-tracking' that simulates VHS tracking errors and horizontal scan line distortions. Implement a complex effect using transform translations that create horizontal displacement waves moving vertically through the element, combined with RGB channel shifts and intermittent static bars. The effect should use clip-path animations to create scan line interruptions. Include parameters for trackingIntensity, scanLineCount, and chromaBleed. Use custom timing functions to create the characteristic 'rolling' motion of VHS tracking errors. Add subtle brightness flickering that accompanies the tracking distortion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined generic effects. Properties: translateX (wave distortion), clipPath (scan lines), filter (RGB split via drop-shadow), brightness. AnimationRange for wave: [{key: 'transform', val: 'translateX(0)', prog: 0}, {key: 'transform', val: 'translateX(10px)', prog: 0.25}, {key: 'transform', val: 'translateX(-10px)', prog: 0.75}]. Clip-path creates horizontal bars. Input params: z.object({trackingIntensity: z.number(), scanLineCount: z.number().int(), chromaBleed: z.number()}). Custom cubic-bezier for rolling motion. Return format: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: transformRanges}, {type: 'generic', ranges: clipPathRanges}]}. Staggered timing for scan line effect.

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset 'grunge-border-decay' that progressively deteriorates the edges of elements to create a weathered, torn appearance. Use SVG filter references combined with animated clip-path polygons that gradually become more irregular. The effect should start with clean edges and progressively add more vertices with random offsets to create tears and rough edges. Implement using multiple animation stages - initial wear, progressive tearing, and final stabilization. Parameters include decaySpeed, edgeVariance, and preserveCorners (boolean to keep corners intact). Add subtle shadow animations that enhance the torn paper illusion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic with SVG filters. Properties: clipPath (polygon with dynamic vertices), filter (url to SVG turbulence), boxShadow. Progressive vertex generation: starts with 4 points, adds random vertices over time. AnimationRange: [{key: 'clipPath', val: 'polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%)', prog: 0}, {key: 'clipPath', val: generateRoughPolygon(8), prog: 0.5}, {key: 'clipPath', val: generateRoughPolygon(16), prog: 1}]. Input params: z.object({decaySpeed: z.number(), edgeVariance: z.number(), preserveCorners: z.boolean()}). Shadow follows edge distortion. Return format: {effects: [{type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, ranges, svgFilters: turbulenceFilter}]}.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset 'analog-color-bleed' that simulates the color bleeding and chromatic aberration found in old analog video. Create a sophisticated color separation effect using multiple text-shadow or box-shadow layers for non-text elements, animated to create shifting RGB channel misalignment. The effect should include color fringing that intensifies at element edges, saturation pumping, and subtle hue rotation. Parameters for bleedIntensity, colorShift (degrees of hue rotation), and edgeFringing. Implement smart detection to use text-shadow for text elements and box-shadow for others. Add a subtle color noise pattern that shifts through the spectrum.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic with conditional property selection. Properties: textShadow OR boxShadow (RGB layers), filter (saturate, hue-rotate), color/backgroundColor. AnimationRange for shadows: [{key: 'boxShadow', val: '0 0 0 transparent', prog: 0}, {key: 'boxShadow', val: '3px 0 0 #ff00ff, -3px 0 0 #00ffff', prog: 0.5}]. Hue rotation: [{key: 'filter', val: 'hue-rotate(0deg)', prog: 0}, {key: 'filter', val: 'hue-rotate(15deg)', prog: 1}]. Input params: z.object({bleedIntensity: z.number(), colorShift: z.number(), edgeFringing: z.boolean()}). Smart property selection based on target type. Return format: {effects: [{type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, ranges: conditionalRanges}]}.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'film-sprocket-damage' that adds the appearance of damaged film sprocket holes and edge burns typical of degraded film reels. Implement using animated mask-image or clip-path to create moving perforations along element edges, combined with gradient overlays for burn marks. The effect should include periodic 'jumps' where the element appears to slip in the projector. Add flickering exposure changes and subtle rotation to enhance the unstable projection feel. Parameters include damageLevel, sprocketSide (left/right/both), and jumpFrequency. Use transform-origin manipulation to make jumps feel mechanical rather than digital.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined generic effects. Properties: maskImage/clipPath (sprocket holes), background (gradient burns), transform (translateY jumps, rotate wobble), opacity (flicker). Sprocket hole pattern via repeating clip-path or mask. AnimationRange for jump: [{key: 'transform', val: 'translateY(0)', prog: 0}, {key: 'transform', val: 'translateY(-5px) rotate(0.5deg)', prog: 0.1}, {key: 'transform', val: 'translateY(0)', prog: 0.15}]. Input params: z.object({damageLevel: z.enum(['light', 'medium', 'heavy']), sprocketSide: z.enum(['left', 'right', 'both']), jumpFrequency: z.number()}). Transform-origin set to 'center top' for mechanical feel. Return format: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: maskRanges}, {type: 'generic', ranges: transformRanges}]}. Staggered timing for organic damage appearance.
